gate_scope: small representation-fitability gate, not the later 30-subject training dataset

capture_bundles.pose: comfortable prone, neutral arms, clean exposed back, no robot
same maintained pose from a second calibrated view or synchronized second RGB-D camera
new comfortable prone placement with head/arm variation, no robot

calibration.extrinsics: 4x4 metric rigid transform between raw depth and RGB optical frames, with direction named explicitly
calibration.depth_unit: store raw scale and canonical meters; verify with measured planar targets at near/mid/far working distances
registration_qa: report planar depth median/P95 absolute error
visually inspect discontinuities at a calibration target

semantic_annotation.view: original RGB and registered depth only; no SAM/MHR mesh overlay
surface_loss_allowed: VISIBLE_BARE_BACK with valid registered depth and acceptable local depth quality
semantic_annotation.quality: two independent masks for held-out observations; adjudicate disagreements and retain UNKNOWN rather than guessing

fit_eval_independence.preferred: fit bundle A; evaluate synchronized calibrated bundle B after applying known camera extrinsics
fit_eval_independence.secondary: fit selected spatial tiles; evaluate disjoint upper/mid/lower and left/right tiles in the same registered frame
fit_eval_independence.secondary_claim_limit: same-frame spatial holdout supports OPTIMIZATION_FEASIBILITY only
fit_eval_independence.never: score the exact depth pixels used by the fitting loss as held-out improvement

future_execution.development_subjects: use at most 1-2 subjects for optimizer/loss-scale choices
future_execution.evaluation_subjects: freeze parameters and thresholds before remaining subjects
future_execution.surface_loss: robust point-to-plane after coordinate/normal validation; point-to-point as diagnostic
future_execution.primary_metric: held-out visible bare-back surface error in mm, subject-macro
future_execution.dmd37: method-to-method displacement only; never target error
